response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth in developer tools, infrastructure, and system design—areas directly relevant to the role—he critically lacks people management and team leadership experience, which is an explicitly stated minimum requirement for this mid-to-senior management position. His career trajectory shows progression as a technical individual contributor (Senior Developer → Staff Engineer) rather than toward people leadership, and there is no evidence of team management, one-on-ones, performance feedback, or organizational development responsibilities. Without foundational people management experience, he cannot fulfill the core "full-time people-leadership" responsibility of this role.
strengths: Deep technical expertise in developer tools, infrastructure, and testing practices (GitLab, CI/CD, Docker, deployment systems, MCP frameworks)
Demonstrated knowledge of system design, microservices architecture, and high-performance systems handling millions of requests per second
Strong commitment to knowledge sharing and engineering excellence through workshops, talks, and community involvement (FOSS4G speaker, organized Code Katas and Refactoring Dojos)
concerns: No demonstrated people management or team leadership experience (fails critical minimum requirement of 2 years people management)
Career trajectory shows deepening in individual technical contribution rather than progression toward management responsibilities
No evidence of strategic roadmap planning, organizational change leadership, performance management, or people development at scale
